srs: The laboratory testing system records Scientist, TestRequest, LabService, and Sample; each has an id attribute. Each Scientist can have zero or more TestRequest records, and each TestRequest belongs to exactly one Scientist. Each TestRequest uses exactly one LabService, and each LabService serves zero or more TestRequest records. Each LabService manages one or more Sample records by composition, and each Sample belongs to exactly one LabService. Each Scientist can reference zero or more Sample records, and each Sample can be referenced by zero or more Scientist records.
